response.overview: The star of this film is Sakura Mio!! With her lustrous long hair, supple and beautiful limbs, small face, and adorable, classic beauty with gorgeous breasts!! Her great figure is also one of her charms, and she's a hard worker who maintains her beauty through kickboxing and exercise. Despite this being her first time working on an image video, the photographer praised her sensual expressions, and the video director lauded her skillful movements, proving she is a truly exceptional talent. Mio herself smiles gently, saying that she was able to express a different side of herself, a new charm, and a more sensual side that is different from her previous videos. In the interview, she spoke at length in her sweet and lovely voice about her thoughts on the film and her private life. A sacred vow colored in pale pink, a soft and sweet story that begins to bloom gently...
